name: Sky Glass Deck
description: A self-contained executive presentation style for publishing teams. It combines precise reporting, serif action titles, square glass panels, and luminous CSS compositions without relying on images.
whatYouGet: Consistent action titles and executive-ready layouts
notFor: Live dashboards with continuously updating metrics
requiredInputs: Approved figures with periods and units

faq.q: Does the deck need image files?
faq.a: No. Its editorial depth is built with CSS gradients, lines, and translucent shapes, so the finished deck works offline.

faq.q: Will it fill gaps in my reporting data?
faq.a: No. Missing sources, periods, or denominators should be identified for review rather than presented as facts.

demoPrompt: /sl-sky-glass-deck Create exactly 9 slides for Regional Publishing Studio’s Q2 2025 executive review, moving from audience growth and reader behavior to a staged test and three Q3 decisions. Treat all figures as illustrative. Title: “Reader growth is creating a stronger case for membership.” Close: “Approve three decisions to make the next quarter measurable.” Use a restrained Sky Glass editorial style.
followUpPrompts: Make the recommendations more specific without changing any reported figures.
Add source notes to each chart and check that every metric has a period.
Tighten the action titles for a board-level audience.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
